links.comparator_used: Same base model as a generic zero-shot LLM and as a cardiology-specialized (domain-prompted) LLM, versus the complete agent with deterministic tools, guideline RAG, memory and a consistency checker (tested as a bundle, not as separate ablations)
links.outcome: Weighted accuracy on nine synthetic cardiovascular cases
links.effect: Weighted accuracy 55.6% (generic LLM), 66.7% (domain prompting), 100% (complete agent); 9/9 correct, 95% Wilson CI 70.1-100%; expected tool invoked in 88.9% of cases, 2.2 tools per query
links.tradeoff: Mean latency 17.7 s, median 8.9 s; one case with repeated retrieval calls took 82.3 s. Only nine synthetic cases, keyword-based scoring and no independent cardiologist adjudication.
links.quote: In a controlled set of nine synthetic cardiovascular cases, weighted accuracy increased from 55.6% for the generic LLM to 66.7% after domain prompting and to 100% with the complete agent.

links.outcome: Weighted accuracy on nine synthetic cardiovascular cases

links.comparator_used: No comparator; functional safety test of the numerical consistency checker on correct and intentionally altered values
links.outcome: Detection of altered numerical values and verification of correct numerical claims
links.effect: Verified 9/9 correct numerical claims and detected 5/5 intentionally altered values; 4 anomalous inputs handled correctly
links.tradeoff: Small synthetic test; no comparison against unverified output.
links.quote: Functional safety checks correctly handled four anomalous inputs, verified nine of nine correct numerical claims, and detected five of five intentionally altered values.

design_hint: retrieval grounding, deterministic tools, and numerical consistency checking added to LLM
